parsed_json.title: Momentum, Elastic Collisions
parsed_json.main_stem: A trolley A moves along a horizontal surface at a constant velocity towards another trolley B which is moving at a lower constant speed in the same direction. Fig. 3.1 shows the trolleys at time $t = 0$. Table 3.1 shows data for the trolleys. Table 3.1: trolley A, mass $0.25\,\mathrm{kg}$, initial speed $0.48\,\mathrm{m}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}$; trolley B, mass $0.75\,\mathrm{kg}$, initial speed $0.12\,\mathrm{m}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}$. The two trolleys collide elastically and then separate. Resistive forces are negligible. Fig. 3.2 shows the variation with time $t$ of the velocity $v$ for trolley B.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is represented by the area under a velocity–time graph.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem: Use Table 3.1 and Fig. 3.2 to determine:
parts.text: the acceleration of trolley B during the collision

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: the magnitude and direction of the final velocity of trolley A.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: On Fig. 3.2, sketch the variation of the velocity of trolley A with time $t$ from $t = 0$ to $t = 0.50\,\mathrm{s}$.

marking_points.text: $a =$ gradient or $a = \Delta v/(\Delta)t$ or $a = (v - u) / t$
direction: to the left / from the right / opposite to (its) initial velocity / opposite to (initial / final) velocity of B
